name: The Nubian Warriors
caption: The Nubian Warriors, AICW's own first-ever World Tag Team Champions, crowned at Apocalypse '97 before losing the belts to the Perfectly Perfect Duo at Seasons Beatings/Violent Night.

name: The Perfectly Perfect Duo

tenures.source: Final Fight (28 November 1999): billed the reigning DWO World Tag Team Champions, retaining the titles against the Natural Born Killers with their own manager's botched interference nearly costing them the match.
The federation's own 2001 cards, roleplays and bulletins, 10 June 2001 to 13 June 2001.
tenures.note: Lance and Max Studd with their manager "Sensuous" Samantha, billed AWP Heavyweight Tag Champions in June 2001 after winning the titles for a second time from the American Renegades.

caption: The Perfectly Perfect Duo, Lance and Max Studd, who won the AICW World Tag Team Championship from the Nubian Warriors at Seasons Beatings/Violent Night and held it through the whole of the surviving record after.

name: The Asian Assassination Squad
caption: The Asian Assassination Squad, Blackjack Takahashi and Thripaq Nguyen, billed as AICW's own North American Tag Team Champions on the fed's own Survival of the Fittest.

name: The Pain Connection
caption: The Pain Connection, "Sadistic" Steve Dunne and "The Masochist" Danny Moore, a recurring AICW tag team tied to the Demonweb stable.

name: Money and Power
caption: Money and Power, Greg Days and Jason Steele, a recurring AICW tag team managed by "Erotic" Erin McCoys.

name: Reign of Terror
caption: Reign of Terror, Armageddon and Abomination, a recurring AICW tag team billed at different points as part of "the Four Souls From Out of Hell."
